title.narrative: Fiji bamboo to adapt and mitigate climate change

description.narrative: One of the projects will aim to enable the uptake of locally suited bamboo species as a resilient material that can support climate change adaptation and provide livelihood opportunities for women/youth. It will combine: i) Knowledge exchange with relevant/applicable experiences (e.g. Philippines -Base Bahay-, INBAR); ii) Training and capacity building; iii) Policy-regulatory reform (e.g. town planning, housing manual, material standards); iv) Proof of concept and project structuring to mobilize 2.5 million USD climate finance to build 500 low income-resilient houses. A second project will address all needs in terms of bamboo supply and agroforestry planning, inventory, harvesting code and policy-regulatory updates (including building code).A focus shall be given to low-income resilient housing to provide suitable solutions for under-served communities, and for women-youth to play a protagonic role within the value chain (e.g. nurseries), as well as other potential income generation opportunities under handycrafts, food security, etc...
